Shipping & Returns

Shipping:

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days (excluding weekends and holidays).

Domestic (U.S.) orders usually arrive within 2-4 business days after processing.

International orders may take 10–21 business days depending on customs and local carriers.

For more info related to shipping, see our shipping policy here.

Returns & Exchanges:

Accepted within 7 days of delivery through your customer account.

For more info related to returns, see our return policy here.

Care Instructions

For Embroidered Items:

  • Machine wash inside-out on lowest heat setting.
  • Air dry if possible. Tumble dry on a low cycle inside-out, on low heat.
  • Avoid using bleach, use non-chlorine bleach if needed.
Lifetime Warranty

We guarantee all the products we make. If a product fails due to a manufacturing defect, you can return it for a replacement or refund.

This warranty does not cover damage caused by accident, improper care and normal wear & tear.

WHY SHOP HAKISTOP?

We love anime.

But let's face it - anime clothing sucks. We set out to fix that.

---

We started as two friends hand-making anime-inspired clothes for fun. After some of our early designs went viral, we launched HakiStop — a brand built for the community that loves fashion & anime as much as we do.

- Devin & Nick

We started as two best friends teaching ourselves screen-printing and sewing to make anime-inspired clothes we actually wanted to wear.

What began as late nights fulfilling hand-made orders in our college apartment is now Hakistop, a brand built to give anime fans the quality and culture they’ve always deserved.
